videos.title: Destination Scientology
videos.description: More than a group of suburbs in Los Angeles, the Valley is the epicenter of the entertainment industry with a mix of ethnicities that gives rise to a culture all its own; the church helps keep this unique community going strong.

videos.title: Signature Performances
videos.description: Grammy Award-winning composer Mark Isham steps into the studio for the most ambitious project of his career; known for his work in jazz, New Age, film and television, he ventures into new territory, blending genres and pushing musical boundaries.

videos.title: I Am a Scientologist
videos.description: A French graphic designer, a Romanian businesswoman and an American documentary filmmaker are a few of the people from around the world featured discussing how Scientology is helping them achieve the life they always wanted.

videos.title: The Way to Happiness
videos.description: The acclaimed common sense guide to better living that inspired a worldwide movement is brought to life through dramatic and interwoven stories. People all over the world use its 21 precepts in their daily lives to achieve fulfilling.

videos.title: Voices for Humanity
videos.description: Catalina Maldonado is bringing hope back to Ecuador, a country long caught in the middle of vicious drug wars and rising violence, by sharing the wisdom of The Way to Happiness. Her work's transformative impact is being hailed by civic leaders.

videos.title: Meet a Scientologist
videos.description: Latin American comic Andrés López discusses growing up in war-torn Colombia, and how he won over audiences with his new form of stand-up comedy.

videos.description: Young visionaries from around the world come to Silicon Valley to pursue their dreams of becoming the next Steve Jobs or Mark Zuckerberg, and the Church of Scientology helps keep those dreams alive.
